mission_05: Define grid-template-areas as a visual map: each string is a row, each quoted name is a column area.
Use grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(200px, 1fr)) to create three columns that are at least 200px and share remaining space equally.
Assign each child element its area using grid-area: header, grid-area: sidebar, etc., and use grid-row: span 2 on the sidebar.
